high_level_description: This image captures a lively street food scene. The main focus is on a person wearing a gray sports bra and a Calvin Klein belt, who appears to be enjoying a meal. They are holding a spoon and seem to be in the process of eating from a large bowl of food placed on their lap. The bowl contains what looks like a dish of biryani or a similar rice-based meal, garnished with yellow saffron strands and green herbs. In the background, there are other people, including a person in a yellow vest who seems to be a vendor or worker at the food stall. There are also some individuals seated and standing
